## 📋 Change Policy for Booking BK-B70889

Your booking is a **Business class, one-way** flight (JFK → LHR). Here's what can and cannot be changed:

---

### ✈️ Change Flights
- ✅ **Allowed** — Business class flights can be modified.
- ⚠️ The **origin (JFK)**, **destination (LHR)**, and **trip type (one-way)** cannot be changed.
- You may switch to a different flight on the same route.
- If you keep some flight segments, their original prices are preserved (not updated to current pricing).
- A single **gift card or credit card** (already in your profile) is required as the payment/refund method for any fare difference.

### 💺 Change Cabin Class
- ✅ **Allowed** — Since your flight has not yet been flown, cabin changes are permitted.
- Cabin class must remain the same across all flights in the reservation.
- If the new cabin price is **higher**, you pay the difference.
- If the new cabin price is **lower**, you receive a refund for the difference.

### 🧳 Change Baggage
- ✅ You **can add** additional checked bags ($50 per extra bag).
- ❌ You **cannot remove** checked bags already on the booking.
- As a **Gold member** with a **Business class** ticket, you are entitled to **4 free checked bags**.

### 🛡️ Change Insurance
- ❌ **Cannot be added** after the initial booking. Your current standard insurance remains in place.

### 👤 Change Passengers
- ✅ You **can modify** passenger details (name, date of birth).
- ❌ You **cannot change the number** of passengers — not even a human agent can do this.

### 💳 Payment for Changes
- If flights are changed, you must provide a **single gift card or credit card** already in your user profile as the payment or refund method.

---
